stem:
Harsh finds small iron nails mixed with sawdust in the school workshop and wants a quick clean-up without picking each nail by hand.

Which method is suitable?

options.text: Use a magnet to pull out the iron nails, because iron is magnetic and sawdust is not.
Use a magnet to pull out any aluminium scraps mixed the same way, because all metals respond to magnets.
Use a magnet on a pile of only iron nails and scrap iron pieces to sort them from each other.
Avoid the magnet for tiny iron bits; magnetic separation cannot work unless each piece is large enough to pick by hand.

teacher.key_rationale: Magnetic separation needs a magnetic component mixed with a non-magnetic one. Aluminium is not magnetic; sorting iron from iron fails; size for handpicking is not the magnetic limit.
